To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the semantic Web is a key enabler for the integration of learning and knowledge management systems.
the semantic Web is a powerful framework to build a TeleLearning Operating system.

1) the integration of learning and knowledge management systems and their components and services in the context of a semantic web is possible, 2) the use of ontologies to describe and organize the knowledge and learning resources, 3) the use of a service oriented architecture, and 4) the use of Web services as a mean to provide interoperability between the different components and services.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the integration of learning and knowledge management in an open and distributed learning environment.
the design and development of a service oriented framework that will support learning and knowledge management in the context of a distributed learning community.
the design of an integrated learning and knowledge management environment that will support the development and use of learning objects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the semantic Web will be the most powerful and effective means of integrating the different learning and knowledge management systems and services.
TELOS is a Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) for learning and knowledge management that uses the Web as its main communication infrastructure.
TELOS is a service-oriented architecture that supports learning and knowledge management.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
TELOS aims to be an integrated learning and knowledge management framework for the semantic Web.
TELOS is an open, distributed, interoperable and extensible framework that provides a set of services to support learning and knowledge management in a service-oriented architecture.

TELOS is a service oriented framework that supports learning and knowledge management by integrating learning object repositories, learning and knowledge management systems, and semantic Web technologies.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the semantic Web is not only an enabling technology, but also an essential element to support learning and knowledge management.
the integration of learning and knowledge management services in a semantic Web context is a promising avenue for future research in this field.
a learning object repository can be seen as a learning knowledge management system that can be integrated in a service oriented framework.
